import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import NoReturn

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` followed by a newline to standard output.

    Console output only: nothing is written to a log file and the file
    system is not touched. The level and message are used as given,
    with no case change or other transformation.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("level", "message", "expected"),
    [
        ("INFO", "hello", "[INFO] hello\n"),
        ("error", "disk full", "[error] disk full\n"),
        ("WARN", "", "[WARN] \n"),
        ("", "no level", "[] no level\n"),
        ("DEBUG", "a [b] c", "[DEBUG] a [b] c\n"),
    ],
)
def test_log_line_format(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    level: str,
    message: str,
    expected: str,
) -> None:
    log_line(level, message)
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == expected
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_multiple_calls_in_order(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "first")
    log_line("ERROR", "second")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] first\n[ERROR] second\n"


def test_log_line_does_not_open_files(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    def forbidden(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> NoReturn:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not touch the file system")

    monkeypatch.setattr("builtins.open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr("io.open", forbidden)
    log_line("INFO", "console only")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"


def test_log_line_creates_no_files(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    log_line("INFO", "nothing on disk")
    log_line("ERROR", "still nothing")
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert os.listdir(tmp_path) == []
